findings.evidence: Same proof inline at Root/Simple.lean:137 and Root/Space.lean:463, and as private lemmas at Positive/StandardComodule.lean:186 and Generated/StandardComodule.lean:204; SplitTorus/Weight.lean has only weightCharacter_coe, toAdd_weightCharacter, weightCharacter_eq_one_iff.
findings.fix: Add public `SplitTorus.weightCharacter_injective` / `@[simp] weightCharacter_inj` in `SplitTorus/Weight.lean` and use it here and at the existing sites.
findings.issue: The local `hinj` (injectivity of `SplitTorus.weightCharacter`) is the fifth copy of the same argument; no public lemma exists.

findings.evidence: Root/Simple.lean:124 `private theorem mem_adjointWeightSpace_liftCharacter_iff (μ : Fin 2 → ℤ)` has the same conclusion shape `∀ i j, weight i - weight j ≠ μ → tangentMatrix x i j = 0`.
findings.fix: Make the general criterion for arbitrary `μ : Fin 2 → ℤ` public in Root.Simple or Root.Space and derive this case from it with `negativeShort_character`.
findings.issue: `mem_negativeShort_weightSpace_iff` copies the private `mem_adjointWeightSpace_liftCharacter_iff` (Root/Simple.lean:124-143): same congrArg/eq_weightTorus/mem_adjointWeightSpace_iff/hinj chain, specialised to one character.

findings.evidence: Lines 239-241: `intro i j h` / `revert h` / `fin_cases k <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> decide`.
findings.fix: Use `intro i j` and leave the hypothesis in the goal for `fin_cases k <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> decide`.
findings.issue: `intro i j h` is immediately followed by `revert h`, which undoes it.

summary: The matrix-normalization proofs are sound and follow the existing pattern, but the PR adds another inline copy of the weightCharacter injectivity argument and copies the private weight-space criterion from Root.Simple instead of factoring both into public lemmas. It also has a pointless intro/revert pair.
